name: Chickpea Cucumber Salad
recipeIngredient: 2 (15 oz) cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed
recipeInstructions: Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and feta in a large bowl.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano, pour over the salad, and toss.
Season to taste and chill 30 minutes before serving.
